entities.name: Web3D Consortium
entities.note: The non-profit organization that develops and maintains the X3D standard.

entities.name: X3D
entities.note: The royalty-free open standards file format and run-time architecture to represent and communicate 3D scenes and objects.

entities.name: X3D 4.0
entities.note: The latest major version of the X3D standard, heavily integrating with HTML5 and modern graphics.

entities.name: VRML
entities.note: Virtual Reality Modeling Language, the predecessor to X3D.

entities.name: X_ITE
entities.note: A modern WebGL-based X3D and VRML browser written in JavaScript.

entities.name: Cobweb
entities.note: The original name of the X_ITE X3D browser before it was renamed.

entities.name: X3DOM
entities.note: An open-source framework and runtime for integrating X3D into HTML5 DOM.

entities.name: Castle Game Engine
entities.note: A cross-platform 3D and 2D game engine supporting X3D and VRML.

entities.name: view3dscene
entities.note: A viewer for 3D models (X3D, VRML, glTF) built on top of the Castle Game Engine.

entities.name: FreeWRL
entities.note: An open-source X3D and VRML browser written in C.

entities.name: InstantReality
entities.note: A high-performance Mixed Reality framework that natively supports X3D.

entities.name: Xj3D
entities.note: An open-source Java implementation of the X3D standard.

entities.name: BS Contact
entities.note: A commercial X3D and VRML viewer developed by Bitmanagement Software.

entities.name: Octaga
entities.note: A high-performance X3D player often used in industrial applications.

entities.name: H3DAPI
entities.note: An open-source haptics software development platform that uses X3D.

entities.name: Titania
entities.note: A graphical 3D editor for X3D developed alongside X_ITE.

entities.name: Holger Seelig
entities.note: The primary author and maintainer of X_ITE and Titania.

entities.name: Johannes Behr
entities.note: A key researcher and developer behind X3DOM and InstantReality.

entities.name: Andreas Plesch
entities.note: A prominent contributor to the X3DOM project.

entities.name: Michalis Kamburelis
entities.note: The lead developer and maintainer of the Castle Game Engine.

entities.name: Doug Sanden
entities.note: A long-time maintainer and developer of FreeWRL.

entities.name: Don Brutzman
entities.note: A leading figure in the Web3D Consortium and Naval Postgraduate School, heavily involved in Xj3D.

entities.name: Fraunhofer IGD
entities.note: A German research institute that originated X3DOM and InstantReality.

entities.name: Bitmanagement Software
entities.note: The company that develops and maintains BS Contact.

entities.name: Naval Postgraduate School
entities.note: A US Navy institution that has hosted and maintained Xj3D and X3D examples.

entities.name: Yumetech
entities.note: A company that historically contributed significantly to Xj3D development.

entities.name: SenseGraphics
entities.note: The organization behind the H3DAPI haptics platform.

entities.name: WebGL
entities.note: A JavaScript API for rendering interactive 2D and 3D graphics within any compatible web browser.

entities.name: HTML5
entities.note: The fifth major HTML version, featuring native support for multimedia and graphics.

entities.name: DOM
entities.note: Document Object Model, an interface that treats an XML or HTML document as a tree structure.

entities.name: JavaScript
entities.note: A core programming language of the World Wide Web.

entities.name: Java
entities.note: A high-level, class-based, object-oriented programming language.

entities.name: Pascal
entities.note: An imperative and procedural programming language, used heavily by Castle Game Engine.
